worldcombat.skill.followme.summary: Beckons on the spot, pulling nearby enemies' attacks onto the caster for as long as the call holds. No type or target restrictions, and no buffs for anyone.
worldcombat.skill.followme.use.0: Take the fire meant for a nearby ally
worldcombat.skill.followme.use.1: Pull enemies off an ally so it can break away
worldcombat.skill.followme.use.2: Block pursuers in the open and gather the fight onto yourself
worldcombat.skill.followme.description.0: Call radius %1$s blocks, attention holds for %2$s. Enemies inside have their attack target repeatedly pointed at you; this does not force them to close in, and they can still move or act as they like.
worldcombat.skill.followme.description.1: Re-pulls every %1$s; once the hold ends it stops retargeting and enemies choose their targets on their own.
worldcombat.skill.followme.shout.on: Shout: radius x1.25 and cooldown x1.1 to sweep in farther enemies, at the cost of hold duration x0.7.
worldcombat.skill.followme.shout.off: Beckon: radius x0.8, but hold duration x1.35 and cooldown x0.9 - hold a few close enemies longer.
worldcombat.skill.followme.timing: A self move; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.followme.preference.sh: On (shout): radius x1.25, hold x0.7, cooldown x1.1 (wide but short). Off (beckon): radius x0.8, hold x1.35, cooldown x0.9 (near but long).
worldcombat.skill.followme.preference.ai: The companion only calls when a living ally is inside this radius; lower calls only at close range, higher draws fire for farther allies.
When an ally falls below this ratio, the call counts as urgent and goes before ordinary combat; higher is more protective, lower waits until an ally is nearly down.
Below this ratio the companion stops drawing fire onto itself; lower takes more hits for others, higher protects itself first.
